decisions.choice: justified: declared to be in the right by God
alternatives: shown to be righteous, proved right before others
decisions.reason: δικαιόω means to declare or acknowledge someone as being in the right, as a judge does. The setting is God's judgment (2:12-13), so the verdict is God's. Some take it here to mean "shown to be righteous", proved by what he did. The two readings are close: in both, Abraham's faith is seen to be real in the offering of Isaac.

decisions.choice: the offering of Isaac: Genesis 22
decisions.reason: In Genesis 22:1-19 God tested Abraham by asking him to offer Isaac. Abraham bound him on the altar, and God stopped him and said, "now I know that you fear God" (22:12). The participle ἀνενέγκας says what he did: he brought his son to the altar and was ready to give him up (Hebrews 11:17).

decisions.choice: our father: Abraham as the ancestor of God's people
decisions.reason: Jewish readers called Abraham "our father" (John 8:39, 53). Paul also calls him the father of all who believe (Romans 4:11-12, 16).

decisions.choice: counted righteous
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep "justified", the word the argument turns on, so that James 2:21-25 can be compared with Romans 3-4. Readable says "counted righteous", which says in plain words what the verdict is (see the meaning decision on δικαιόω).

decisions.choice: his actions
decisions.reason: Readable says "actions" for ἔργον, a common word for what people do; Literal and Balanced keep "works" through 2:14-26 so that the argument's key word stays visible.

decisions.choice: fue justificado (L, B); fue declarado justo (R)
decisions.reason: James uses the same verb as Paul, and the translation uses the same Spanish words as Romans and Galatians, "justificar" (Literal, Balanced) and "declarar justo" (Readable), so a reader can see that the two writers share one verb and weigh them side by side (see the meaning decision at 2:24). Readable says "declarado justo" where the English Readable says "counted righteous", to match Spanish Romans.

decisions.choice: kuhesabiwa haki
decisions.reason: James uses the same verb as Paul, and "kuhesabiwa haki" is the Swahili of Romans and Galatians at every level, so a reader can see that the two writers share one verb and weigh them side by side (see the meaning decision at 2:24).

decisions.choice: passé simple for the stories of Abraham and Rahab at Literal and Balanced (fut justifié, offrit, crut, fut appelé, accueillit); passé composé at Readable; James’s own argument in the present at every level (2:22 "tu vois", 2:24)
decisions.reason: As set out in 1:1: the retold stories of Genesis 22 and Joshua 2 are narrative, and the passé simple is the tense of written narrative; Readable uses the passé composé of spoken French.

decisions.choice: justifié (L, B); déclaré juste (R) (also 2:24-25)
decisions.reason: "Justifier" is the French theological word, and its everyday sense (to give reasons for something) does not get in the way here, so Literal and Balanced keep it, matching Paul’s word. Readable says "déclaré juste", as in Romans and Galatians: God’s verdict that a person is in the right (m1).

decisions.choice: "의롭다고 인정받다" (L, B); "하나님께 의로운 사람으로 인정받다" (R), here and in verses 24-25
decisions.reason: The same Korean as the Korean Romans ("의롭다고 인정하다") for the same verb, so the reader can compare the two letters, as the meaning decision at 2:24 asks; that decision and the one here say what James means by it. Readable names God, as the English Readable says "counted righteous".

decisions.choice: "우리 조상" for "our father"
decisions.reason: Abraham is the ancestor of God's people (meaning decision); "아버지" would suggest a parent.

decisions.choice: "được xưng công chính" (L, B); "được Đức Chúa Trời công nhận là công chính" (R), here and in 2:24-25
decisions.reason: The verb is the one the Vietnamese Romans renders "xưng công chính" (2:13), to be declared in the right by God, the reading of m1; keeping the same word lets the reader set James beside Paul (m1 in 2:24). Readable says it plainly, as the Vietnamese Romans does at Readable.

decisions.choice: "Áp-ra-ham", "Y-sác", "Ra-háp" (2:25), "Gióp" (5:11), "Ê-li" (5:17); "tổ phụ" (L, B, R) for "our father"
decisions.reason: The Protestant forms of the names, as the style guide sets them. "Tổ phụ" is the word for Abraham as forefather of God's people (m3), as in the Vietnamese Romans (4:1).

decisions.choice: justificado (L); declarado justo (B); aceito por Deus como justo (R)
decisions.reason: For 2:21-25: the same words as Romans 3-4 in Portuguese ("justificado", "declarado justo", "aceito por Deus como justo"), so that James and Paul can be compared word for word, as the English keeps "justified" for the same reason.

decisions.choice: ጸደቀ (was justified) at Literal and Balanced; ጻድቅ ተብሎ ተቆጠረ (was counted righteous) at Readable
alternatives: ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር ትክክለኛ ግንኙነት አገኘ (came into a right relationship with God), the Readable phrase in Romans
decisions.reason: "ጸደቀ" is the verb used for Paul's justify (Romans 3:28; 4:2), so readers can compare the two letters, which use one verb for two answers to two questions (meaning decision on 2:24). Readable follows the English "counted righteous" and links to verse 23's "ተቆጠረለት" (it was counted to him).

decisions.choice: "धर्मी ठहराना" at every level
decisions.reason: The key term of Romans, kept at every level in 2:21-25 so that James can be compared with Romans 3-4, where the same verb and the same Abraham stand (English rendering decision). Readable names God as the one who declares, as the English Readable says "counted".

decisions.choice: оправдаться, оправдать
decisions.reason: Romans settles "оправдать" at every level, so it is kept here too, Readable included (where the English says "counted righteous"), and James 2:21-25 can be set beside Romans 3-4. Readable names God as the one who justifies.

decisions.choice: "виправданий, тобто визнаний праведним" (R), then "виправданий"
alternatives: "визнаний праведним" alone, as the English Readable "counted righteous"
decisions.reason: The brief keeps "виправдати" at every level in Romans and James so that readers can set the two letters side by side; Readable explains the word once here and then uses it plainly.
m3: Abraham as the ancestor of God's people. "わたしたちの父" can read as the readers' own father in plain Japanese, so Readable says ancestor.

source.text: βλέπεις ὅτι ἡ πίστις συνήργει τοῖς ἔργοις αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐκ τῶν ἔργων ἡ πίστις ἐτελειώθη, καὶ ἐπληρώθη ἡ γραφὴ ἡ λέγουσα· Ἐπίστευσεν δὲ Ἀβραὰμ τῷ θεῷ, καὶ ἐλογίσθη αὐτῷ εἰς δικαιοσύνην, καὶ φίλος θεοῦ ἐκλήθη.

records.literal_gloss: You see that the faith worked with the works of him, and by the works the faith was perfected, \v 23 and was fulfilled the Scripture the [one] saying, Believed and Abraham the God, and it was credited to him for righteousness, and friend of God he was called.

en.L: You see that faith was working along with his works, and from the works faith was brought to completion, \v 23 and the Scripture was fulfilled that says, "And Abraham believed God, and it was credited to him for righteousness," and he was called friend of God.
en.B: You can see that his faith worked together with his works, and his faith reached its goal through those works. \v 23 So the Scripture came true that says, "Abraham believed God, and it was credited to him as righteousness," and he was called God's friend.
en.R: You can see that his faith and his actions were working together. His faith was made complete by what he did. \v 23 In this way the words of Scripture came true: "Abraham believed God, and God counted that as righteousness for him." And Abraham was called God's friend.

es.L: Ves que la fe actuaba junto con sus obras, y por las obras la fe fue llevada a su plenitud, \v 23 y se cumplió la Escritura que dice: «Y creyó Abraham a Dios, y le fue acreditado como justicia», y fue llamado amigo de Dios.
es.B: Puedes ver que su fe actuaba junto con sus obras, y que por medio de esas obras su fe alcanzó su meta. \v 23 Así se cumplió la Escritura que dice: «Abraham creyó a Dios, y eso se le acreditó como justicia», y fue llamado amigo de Dios.
es.R: Puedes ver que su fe y sus obras actuaban juntas. Su fe se completó por lo que hizo. \v 23 Así se cumplieron las palabras de la Escritura: «Abraham creyó a Dios, y Dios le acreditó esa fe como justicia». Y a Abraham lo llamaron amigo de Dios.

sw.L: Unaona kwamba imani ilikuwa ikitenda kazi pamoja na matendo yake, na kwa matendo imani ilikamilishwa, \v 23 na Maandiko yakatimizwa yasemayo, "Naye Abrahamu alimwamini Mungu, na [hilo] likahesabiwa kwake kuwa haki," naye akaitwa rafiki wa Mungu.
sw.B: Unaweza kuona kwamba imani yake ilifanya kazi pamoja na matendo yake, na kupitia matendo hayo imani yake ikafikia ukamilifu wake. \v 23 Hivyo yakatimia Maandiko yanayosema, "Abrahamu alimwamini Mungu, na hilo likahesabiwa kwake kuwa haki," naye akaitwa rafiki wa Mungu.
sw.R: Unaweza kuona kwamba imani yake na matendo yake vilikuwa vikifanya kazi pamoja. Imani yake ilikamilishwa kwa yale aliyotenda. \v 23 Kwa njia hii maneno ya Maandiko yalitimia: "Abrahamu alimwamini Mungu, na Mungu akamhesabu kuwa mwenye haki kwa sababu hiyo." Na Abrahamu akaitwa rafiki wa Mungu.

fr.L: Tu vois que la foi agissait avec ses œuvres, et que par les œuvres la foi fut menée à son accomplissement, \v 23 et l’Écriture fut accomplie, qui dit : « Or Abraham crut Dieu, et cela lui fut compté comme justice », et il fut appelé ami de Dieu.
fr.B: Tu vois que sa foi agissait avec ses œuvres, et que par ses œuvres sa foi atteignit son but. \v 23 Ainsi s’accomplit l’Écriture qui dit : « Abraham crut Dieu, et cela lui fut compté comme justice », et il fut appelé ami de Dieu.
fr.R: Tu vois que sa foi et ses actes agissaient ensemble. Sa foi a été rendue complète par ce qu’il a fait. \v 23 C’est ainsi que les paroles de l’Écriture se sont réalisées : « Abraham a cru Dieu, et Dieu a compté cela comme justice pour lui. » Et Abraham a été appelé l’ami de Dieu.

ko.L: 당신이 보는 대로, 믿음이 그의 행함과 함께 일했고, 행함으로 믿음이 완전하게 되었습니다. \v 23 그리하여 "아브라함이 하나님을 믿었고, 그것이 그에게 의로 여겨졌다"고 말하는 성경이 이루어졌고, 그는 하나님의 친구라고 불렸습니다.
ko.B: 당신도 알 수 있듯이, 그의 믿음은 그의 행함과 함께 일했고, 그 행함으로 그의 믿음은 목적을 이루었습니다. \v 23 이렇게 해서 "아브라함이 하나님을 믿으니, 그것이 그에게 의로 여겨졌다" 한 성경 말씀이 이루어졌고, 그는 하나님의 친구라고 불렸습니다.
ko.R: 당신도 알 수 있듯이, 그의 믿음과 행동은 함께 일하고 있었습니다. 그가 한 일로 그의 믿음이 완전해졌습니다. \v 23 이렇게 해서 성경 말씀이 이루어졌습니다. "아브라함이 하나님을 믿었고, 하나님께서는 그것을 의로 여겨 주셨다." 그리고 아브라함은 하나님의 친구라고 불렸습니다.

vi.L: Bạn thấy rằng đức tin đã cùng hành động với việc làm của ông, và bởi việc làm mà đức tin được làm cho trọn vẹn, \v 23 và lời Kinh Thánh đã được ứng nghiệm, là lời nói rằng: "Áp-ra-ham tin Đức Chúa Trời, và điều đó được kể cho ông là sự công chính", và ông được gọi là bạn của Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: Bạn thấy đó, đức tin của ông cùng hành động với việc làm của ông, và nhờ việc làm mà đức tin của ông đạt đến mục đích trọn vẹn. \v 23 Như vậy, lời Kinh Thánh đã được ứng nghiệm: "Áp-ra-ham tin Đức Chúa Trời, và điều đó được kể là sự công chính cho ông", và ông được gọi là bạn của Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.R: Bạn có thể thấy đức tin và hành động của ông cùng làm việc với nhau. Đức tin của ông được trọn vẹn nhờ những gì ông làm. \v 23 Như vậy lời Kinh Thánh đã thành sự thật: "Áp-ra-ham tin Đức Chúa Trời, và Đức Chúa Trời kể điều đó là sự công chính cho ông." Và Áp-ra-ham được gọi là bạn của Đức Chúa Trời.

pt.L: Você vê que a fé atuava junto com as obras dele, e pelas obras a fé foi aperfeiçoada, \v 23 e se cumpriu a Escritura que diz: "E Abraão creu em Deus, e isso lhe foi contado como justiça", e ele foi chamado amigo de Deus.
pt.B: Você pode ver que a fé dele agia junto com as suas obras, e que pelas obras a sua fé chegou à plenitude. \v 23 Assim se cumpriu a Escritura que diz: "Abraão creu em Deus, e isso lhe foi contado como justiça", e ele foi chamado amigo de Deus.
pt.R: Você pode ver que a fé de Abraão e as suas ações trabalhavam juntas. A fé dele se tornou completa por meio do que ele fez. \v 23 Assim aconteceu o que as Escrituras dizem: "Abraão acreditou em Deus, e Deus contou isso como justiça para ele." E Abraão foi chamado amigo de Deus.

am.L: እምነት ከሥራው ጋር አብሮ ይሠራ እንደ ነበረ፣ ከሥራውም እምነት ፍጹም እንደ ሆነ ታያለህ፤ \v 23 «አብርሃምም እግዚአብሔርን አመነ፤ ጽድቅም ሆኖ ተቆጠረለት» የሚለው መጽሐፍ ተፈጸመ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ወዳጅ ተባለ።
am.B: እምነቱ ከሥራው ጋር አብሮ እንደ ሠራ፣ እምነቱም በሥራው ግቡን እንደ ደረሰ ታያለህ። \v 23 በዚህም «አብርሃም እግዚአብሔርን አመነ፤ ይህም ጽድቅ ሆኖ ተቆጠረለት» የሚለው መጽሐፍ ተፈጸመ፤ እርሱም የእግዚአብሔር ወዳጅ ተባለ።
am.R: እምነቱና ተግባሩ አብረው ይሠሩ እንደ ነበረ ታያለህ። እምነቱ ፍጹም የሆነው ባደረገው ነገር ነው። \v 23 በዚህ መንገድ «አብርሃም እግዚአብሔርን አመነ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ያንን እንደ ጽድቅ ቆጠረለት» የሚለው የመጽሐፍ ቃል እውነት ሆነ። አብርሃምም የእግዚአብሔር ወዳጅ ተባለ።

hi.L: तुम देखते हो कि विश्वास उसके कामों के साथ मिलकर काम कर रहा था, और कामों से विश्वास सिद्ध हुआ, \v 23 और पवित्रशास्त्र का यह वचन पूरा हुआ जो कहता है, "और अब्राहम ने परमेश्वर पर विश्वास किया, और यह उसके लिए धार्मिकता गिना गया," और वह परमेश्वर का मित्र कहलाया।
hi.B: तुम देख सकते हो कि उसका विश्वास उसके कामों के साथ मिलकर काम करता था, और उन कामों के द्वारा उसका विश्वास अपने लक्ष्य तक पहुँचा। \v 23 इस तरह पवित्रशास्त्र का यह वचन पूरा हुआ, "अब्राहम ने परमेश्वर पर विश्वास किया, और उसका यह विश्वास उसके लिए धार्मिकता गिना गया," और वह परमेश्वर का मित्र कहलाया।
hi.R: तुम देख सकते हो कि उसका विश्वास और उसके काम साथ-साथ काम कर रहे थे। जो उसने किया, उससे उसका विश्वास पूरा हुआ। \v 23 इस तरह पवित्रशास्त्र का यह वचन सच हुआ: "अब्राहम ने परमेश्वर पर विश्वास किया, और परमेश्वर ने उसे धार्मिकता गिना।" और अब्राहम परमेश्वर का मित्र कहलाया।

ru.L: Видишь, что вера содействовала делам его, и из дел вера достигла совершенства, \v 23 и исполнилось Писание, которое говорит: «И поверил Авраам Богу, и это было зачтено ему в праведность», и другом Божьим он был назван.
ru.B: Ты видишь, что его вера действовала вместе с его делами и через дела достигла своей цели. \v 23 Так исполнилось слово Писания: «Авраам поверил Богу, и это было зачтено ему как праведность», и он был назван другом Бога.
ru.R: Ты видишь, что его вера и его дела действовали вместе. Его вера стала полной благодаря тому, что он сделал. \v 23 Так сбылись слова Писания: «Авраам поверил Богу, и Бог зачёл это ему как праведность.» И Авраама назвали другом Бога.

uk.L: Бачиш, що віра діяла разом з його ділами, і з діл віра стала досконалою, \v 23 і здійснилося Писання, що каже: «Повірив же Авраам Богові, і це зараховано йому за праведність», і другом Божим його названо.
uk.B: Ти бачиш, що його віра діяла разом з його ділами і через ці діла досягла своєї мети. \v 23 Так здійснилося Писання, яке каже: «Авраам повірив Богові, і це було зараховано йому як праведність», і його назвали Божим другом.
uk.R: Ти бачиш, що його віра і його вчинки діяли разом. Його віра стала повною через те, що він зробив. \v 23 Так здійснилися слова Писання: «Авраам повірив Богові, і Бог зарахував йому це як праведність.» І Авраама назвали Божим другом.

ja.L: あなたが見ているとおり、信仰が彼の行いと共に働き、行いによって信仰が完全にされました。\v 23 そして、「アブラハムは神を信じた。そして、それが彼に義と見なされた」と言う聖書[の言葉]が成就し、彼は神の友と呼ばれました。
ja.B: あなたにもわかるように、彼の信仰は行いと共に働き、その行いによって信仰は目標に達したのです。\v 23 こうして、「アブラハムは神を信じた。それが彼の義と見なされた」という聖書の言葉が実現し、彼は神の友と呼ばれました。
ja.R: あなたにもわかるでしょう。アブラハムの信仰と行動は、いっしょに働いていました。アブラハムのしたことによって、その信仰は完全なものになったのです。\v 23 こうして、聖書の言葉が実現しました。「アブラハムは神を信じた。神は、そのことによってアブラハムを正しい者と認めた。」そして、アブラハムは神の友と呼ばれました。

decisions.choice: faith was working with his works: faith and works acting together
decisions.reason: συνήργει ("was working with") is in the imperfect: through Abraham's life his faith was at work in what he did. Faith was not idle (2:20) but active in his works.

decisions.choice: made complete: brought to its full goal
alternatives: made perfect, as if faith had been faulty before
decisions.reason: τελειόω means to bring something to its goal or full growth. Abraham's faith was real before Genesis 22, but in the offering of Isaac it reached the maturity James speaks of in 1:4.

decisions.choice: the Scripture fulfilled: Genesis 15:6 shown true in Genesis 22
decisions.reason: James quotes Genesis 15:6, words spoken long before the offering of Isaac (Genesis 22). "Fulfilled" here means that the later event showed the full truth of the earlier word: the faith that God counted as righteousness was the kind that obeys. Paul quotes the same verse in Romans 4:3 and Galatians 3:6.

decisions.choice: friend of God: 2 Chronicles 20:7; Isaiah 41:8
decisions.reason: The title is not part of Genesis 15:6 but comes from 2 Chronicles 20:7 and Isaiah 41:8, where God calls Abraham "my friend".

decisions.choice: God counted that as righteousness for him
alternatives: it was credited to him as righteousness
decisions.reason: Readable names God as the one who credits, which the passive leaves implicit.

decisions.choice: his actions
decisions.reason: Readable says "actions" for ἔργον, a common word for what people do; Literal and Balanced keep "works" through 2:14-26 so that the argument's key word stays visible.

decisions.choice: acreditado como justicia (L); se le acreditó como justicia (B, R)
decisions.reason: Genesis 15:6 is quoted in the same words as Galatians 3:6 (and later Romans 4:3), so a reader can see that James and Paul cite one verse. "Acreditar" is the Spanish bookkeeping word for entering something to a person's account, which is the sense of the meaning decision; "contado por justicia" is the traditional wording, and "imputar" now usually means to charge someone with a crime.

decisions.choice: likahesabiwa kwake kuwa haki (L, B); Mungu akamhesabu kuwa mwenye haki (R)
decisions.reason: ἐλογίσθη is rendered with -hesabu, the same verb as "kuhesabiwa haki" (justified) in 2:21 and 2:24, so the Swahili reader hears the link between Genesis 15:6 and James's argument that the Greek makes with δικαιοσύνην and ἐδικαιώθη. Readable follows the English Readable in naming God as the one who counts.

decisions.choice: Abraham crut Dieu (L, B); a cru Dieu (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek has God in the dative, without a preposition: Abraham believed what God said to him (Genesis 15:6). French "croire quelqu’un" says exactly that, where "croire en Dieu" would mean believing that God exists or trusting him in general.

decisions.choice: Genesis 15:6 in the words of the Korean Romans 4:3 at each level
decisions.reason: Paul quotes the same verse in Romans 4:3; giving it the same Korean lets the reader see that both letters stand on one Scripture.

decisions.choice: isso lhe foi contado como justiça (L, B); Deus contou isso como justiça (R)
decisions.reason: Genesis 15:6 is quoted in the words of Romans 4:3 in Portuguese, since both letters quote the same verse and m3 sends the reader to Paul.

decisions.choice: Genesis 15:6 in the Amharic of Romans 4:3 ("አብርሃም እግዚአብሔርን አመነ፤ ... ተቆጠረለት")
decisions.reason: James and Paul quote the same Greek sentence; giving it the same Amharic at each level lets a reader see that both letters stand on one verse.

decisions.choice: the wording of Romans 4:3 for Genesis 15:6
decisions.reason: The quotation is the one Paul quotes in Romans 4:3, so each level keeps that Hindi wording ("धार्मिकता गिना गया"); Literal adds "और" for the Greek "de", which Romans does not have.

decisions.choice: Genesis 15:6 as in Romans 4:3
decisions.reason: The Greek of the quotation is the same as in Romans 4:3, so its Russian wording is kept at each level.

source.text: ὁρᾶτε ὅτι ἐξ ἔργων δικαιοῦται ἄνθρωπος καὶ οὐκ ἐκ πίστεως μόνον.

records.literal_gloss: You see that by works is justified a man and not by faith only.

en.L: You see that by works a person is justified, and not by faith alone.
en.B: You see, then, that it is by works that a person is justified, and not by faith only.
en.R: So you see that a person is counted righteous because of actions, and not because of faith alone.

es.L: {{plural_you:Ven|Veis}} que por obras es justificada una persona, y no por fe solamente.
es.B: {{plural_you:Ven|Veis}}, pues, que una persona es justificada por las obras, y no solamente por la fe.
es.R: Así que {{plural_you:ya ven|ya veis}} que una persona es declarada justa por sus obras, y no solo por la fe.

sw.L: Mnaona kwamba kutokana na matendo mtu anahesabiwa haki, na si kutokana na imani tu.
sw.B: Basi mnaona kwamba ni kwa matendo mtu anahesabiwa haki, wala si kwa imani pekee.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo mnaona kwamba mtu anahesabiwa haki kwa sababu ya matendo yake, na si kwa sababu ya imani peke yake.

fr.L: Vous voyez que par les œuvres {{gender:un être humain|un homme}} est justifié, et non par la foi seulement.
fr.B: Vous voyez donc que c’est par les œuvres qu’on est justifié, et non par la foi seulement.
fr.R: Vous voyez donc qu’on est déclaré juste à cause de ses actes, et pas seulement à cause de sa foi.

ko.L: 여러분이 보는 대로, 사람은 행함으로 의롭다고 인정받는 것이지, 믿음으로만 [인정받는 것이] 아닙니다.
ko.B: 그러니 여러분도 알 수 있듯이, 사람은 행함으로 의롭다고 인정받는 것이지, 믿음만으로 인정받는 것이 아닙니다.
ko.R: 그러니 여러분도 알 수 있듯이, 사람은 행동으로 하나님께 의로운 사람으로 인정받는 것이지, 믿음만으로 인정받는 것이 아닙니다.

vi.L: Anh chị em thấy rằng con người được xưng công chính bởi việc làm, chứ không phải chỉ bởi đức tin mà thôi.
vi.B: Vậy anh chị em thấy đó, con người được xưng công chính bởi việc làm, chứ không phải chỉ bởi đức tin.
vi.R: Vậy anh chị em thấy rằng một người được Đức Chúa Trời công nhận là công chính vì hành động, chứ không phải chỉ vì đức tin mà thôi.

pt.L: Vocês veem que uma pessoa é justificada pelas obras, e não somente pela fé.
pt.B: Vocês veem, então, que é pelas obras que uma pessoa é declarada justa, e não só pela fé.
pt.R: Assim vocês veem que uma pessoa é aceita por Deus como justa por causa das suas ações, e não somente por causa da fé.

am.L: ሰው በሥራ እንደሚጸድቅ፣ በእምነት ብቻም እንዳልሆነ ታያላችሁ።
am.B: እንግዲህ ሰው የሚጸድቀው በሥራ እንደ ሆነ፣ በእምነት ብቻ እንዳልሆነ ታያላችሁ።
am.R: ስለዚህ ሰው ጻድቅ ተብሎ የሚቆጠረው በተግባሩ ምክንያት እንደ ሆነ፣ በእምነት ብቻ እንዳልሆነ ታያላችሁ።

hi.L: तुम देखते हो कि मनुष्य कामों से धर्मी ठहराया जाता है, और केवल विश्वास से नहीं।
hi.B: तो तुम देखते हो कि मनुष्य कामों से धर्मी ठहराया जाता है, न कि केवल विश्वास से।
hi.R: तो तुम देखते हो कि परमेश्वर मनुष्य को उसके कामों के कारण धर्मी ठहराते हैं, न कि केवल विश्वास के कारण।

ru.L: Видите, что человек оправдывается делами, а не только верой.
ru.B: Итак, вы видите, что человек оправдывается делами, а не одной только верой.
ru.R: Итак, вы видите: Бог оправдывает человека из-за его дел, а не только из-за веры.

uk.L: Бачите, що з діл виправдовується людина, а не з самої лише віри.
uk.B: Отже, бачите, що людина виправдовується ділами, а не тільки вірою.
uk.R: Тож ви бачите, що людина виправдана через учинки, а не лише через віру.

ja.L: あなたがたが見ているとおり、人は行いによって義とされるのであって、信仰だけによって[義とされるの]ではありません。
ja.B: これで、あなたがたにもわかるとおり、人が義とされるのは行いによるのであり、信仰だけによるのではありません。
ja.R: ですから、みなさんにもわかるでしょう。人が神に正しい者と認められるのは、行動によるのであって、信仰だけによるのではないのです。

decisions.choice: James and Paul: two answers to two different questions
decisions.reason: Paul writes that that a person is justified by faith without works of the law (Romans 3:28) and that Abraham was not justified by works (Romans 4:2-3). Both he and James quote Genesis 15:6. But Paul's "works of the law" are the things a person might do to earn God's favor, while James's works are the deeds that faith produces (2:15-16, 22). James's "faith alone" is the faith of 2:14 and 2:19: a claim and an agreement with facts, which demons share. Paul too speaks of faith that is at work through love (Galatians 5:6). James answers someone who says faith needs no deeds; Paul answers someone who says deeds can earn a verdict.

decisions.choice: not by faith alone: not by a faith that stands alone
alternatives: not by faith, but by works instead
decisions.reason: μόνον is an adverb: a person is not justified "only by faith" in the sense James has shown, a faith that has no works. He does not say faith plays no part; verse 22 says faith and works acted together.

decisions.choice: you see: now plural
decisions.reason: ὁρᾶτε is plural. After speaking to one objector (2:18-22, singular), James turns back to all his readers to draw the conclusion.

decisions.choice: counted righteous
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep "justified", the word the argument turns on, so that James 2:21-25 can be compared with Romans 3-4. Readable says "counted righteous", which says in plain words what the verdict is (see the meaning decision on δικαιόω).

decisions.choice: {{gender:un être humain|un homme}} (L); on (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word means a human being, man or woman. Literal keeps the noun and carries the setting; Balanced and Readable use the already inclusive "on". "Vous voyez" is plural again (m3), after the singular of 2:18-23.

decisions.choice: "여러분" again for the plural "you see"
decisions.reason: The verb is now plural (meaning decision): James turns from the imagined objector back to all his readers, and Korean shows it by returning to "여러분".

decisions.choice: "Anh chị em" for "you see", now plural
decisions.reason: The verb is plural here (m3): James turns from the imagined hearer back to the whole church, so Vietnamese returns from "bạn" to "anh chị em".

decisions.choice: "あなたがた" (L, B), "みなさん" (R) after "あなた" in 2:18-22
decisions.reason: m3: the verb is now plural, as James turns from the one objector back to all his readers. Japanese marks the change with the plural pronoun.

source.text: ὁμοίως δὲ καὶ Ῥαὰβ ἡ πόρνη οὐκ ἐξ ἔργων ἐδικαιώθη, ὑποδεξαμένη τοὺς ἀγγέλους καὶ ἑτέρᾳ ὁδῷ ἐκβαλοῦσα;

records.literal_gloss: Likewise and also Rahab the prostitute not by works was justified, having received the messengers and by another way having sent [them] out?

en.L: And likewise also Rahab the prostitute, was she not justified by works, having received the messengers and sent [them] out by another way?
en.B: In the same way, was not Rahab the prostitute also justified by works when she welcomed the messengers and sent them off by a different road?
en.R: It was the same with Rahab, the prostitute. Was she not counted righteous because of her actions? She welcomed the men who came as messengers and helped them escape by another road.

es.L: Y de igual manera también Rahab la prostituta, ¿no fue justificada por obras, cuando recibió a los mensajeros y [los] hizo salir por otro camino?
es.B: Del mismo modo, ¿no fue también justificada por las obras Rahab la prostituta, cuando acogió a los mensajeros y los despidió por otro camino?
es.R: Lo mismo pasó con Rahab, la prostituta. ¿No fue declarada justa por sus obras? Ella recibió a los hombres que llegaron como mensajeros y los ayudó a escapar por otro camino.

sw.L: Na vivyo hivyo pia Rahabu yule kahaba, je, hakuhesabiwa haki kutokana na matendo, alipowapokea wale wajumbe na kuwatoa nje kupitia njia nyingine?
sw.B: Vivyo hivyo, je, Rahabu yule kahaba naye hakuhesabiwa haki kwa matendo, alipowapokea wajumbe na kuwaondoa kwa njia tofauti?
sw.R: Ilikuwa vivyo hivyo kwa Rahabu, yule kahaba. Je, hakuhesabiwa haki kwa sababu ya matendo yake? Aliwakaribisha watu waliokuja kama wajumbe, akawasaidia kutoroka kwa njia nyingine.

fr.L: Et de même Rahab la prostituée aussi ne fut-elle pas justifiée par les œuvres, ayant accueilli les messagers et [les] ayant fait sortir par un autre chemin ?
fr.B: De même, Rahab la prostituée ne fut-elle pas, elle aussi, justifiée par les œuvres, quand elle accueillit les messagers et les fit repartir par un autre chemin ?
fr.R: C’est la même chose pour Rahab, la prostituée. N’a-t-elle pas été déclarée juste à cause de ses actes ? Elle a accueilli les hommes venus comme messagers et les a aidés à s’enfuir par un autre chemin.

ko.L: 또 마찬가지로 창녀 라합도 사자들을 맞아들이고 다른 길로 내보냈을 때, 행함으로 의롭다고 인정받은 것이 아닙니까?
ko.B: 마찬가지로 창녀 라합도 정탐꾼들을 맞아들였다가 다른 길로 떠나보냈을 때, 행함으로 의롭다고 인정받은 것이 아닙니까?
ko.R: 창녀 라합도 마찬가지였습니다. 그 여자도 행동 때문에 의로운 사람으로 인정받지 않았습니까? 라합은 정탐하러 온 사람들을 맞아들였고, 그들이 다른 길로 도망치도록 도와주었습니다.

vi.L: Cũng vậy, kỹ nữ Ra-háp chẳng phải cũng đã được xưng công chính bởi việc làm, khi tiếp đón các sứ giả và cho [họ] đi theo một đường khác sao?
vi.B: Cũng thế, chẳng phải kỹ nữ Ra-háp cũng được xưng công chính bởi việc làm khi bà tiếp đón các sứ giả và đưa họ đi theo một con đường khác sao?
vi.R: Ra-háp, người kỹ nữ, cũng vậy. Chẳng phải bà được Đức Chúa Trời công nhận là công chính vì hành động của mình sao? Bà đã tiếp đón những người được sai đến làm sứ giả và giúp họ trốn thoát theo một con đường khác.

pt.L: E do mesmo modo também Raabe, a prostituta, não foi justificada pelas obras, tendo recebido os mensageiros e [os] feito sair por outro caminho?
pt.B: Do mesmo modo, a prostituta Raabe também não foi declarada justa pelas obras, quando acolheu os mensageiros e os mandou embora por outro caminho?
pt.R: Com Raabe, a prostituta, aconteceu a mesma coisa. Ela não foi aceita por Deus como justa por causa das suas ações? Ela recebeu bem os homens que tinham vindo como mensageiros e os ajudou a fugir por outro caminho.

am.L: እንዲሁም ደግሞ ጋለሞታይቱ ረዓብ መልእክተኞቹን ተቀብላ በሌላ መንገድ አስወጥታ በሥራ አልጸደቀችምን?
am.B: እንደዚሁም ጋለሞታይቱ ረዓብ መልእክተኞቹን ተቀብላ በሌላ መንገድ በሸኘቻቸው ጊዜ በሥራ አልጸደቀችምን?
am.R: ጋለሞታይቱ ረዓብም እንደዚሁ ናት። በተግባሯ ምክንያት ጻድቅ ተብላ አልተቆጠረችምን? መልእክተኞች ሆነው የመጡትን ሰዎች ተቀበለች፤ በሌላ መንገድ እንዲያመልጡም ረዳቻቸው።

hi.L: और इसी प्रकार राहाब वेश्या भी, क्या वह कामों से धर्मी नहीं ठहराई गई, जब उसने दूतों को अपने यहाँ ठहराया और दूसरे मार्ग से निकाल दिया?
hi.B: इसी तरह, क्या राहाब वेश्या भी कामों से धर्मी नहीं ठहराई गई, जब उसने दूतों का स्वागत किया और उन्हें दूसरे रास्ते से भेज दिया?
hi.R: राहाब वेश्या के साथ भी ऐसा ही हुआ। क्या परमेश्वर ने उसके कामों के कारण उसे धर्मी नहीं ठहराया? उसने उन आदमियों का स्वागत किया जो दूत बनकर आए थे, और उन्हें दूसरे रास्ते से बच निकलने में सहायता की।

ru.L: Подобно и Раав блудница не делами ли оправдалась, приняв посланцев и выпустив [их] другой дорогой?
ru.B: Так же и Раав, блудница: разве не делами она была оправдана, когда приняла посланцев и отправила их другой дорогой?
ru.R: То же самое было и с Раав, блудницей. Разве Бог не оправдал её за её дела? Она приняла людей, которые пришли как посланцы, и помогла им уйти другой дорогой.

uk.L: Так само й Рахав, блудниця, хіба не з діл була виправдана, прийнявши посланців і випустивши [їх] іншою дорогою?
uk.B: Так само й Рахав, блудниця, хіба не ділами була виправдана, коли прийняла посланців і відпустила їх іншою дорогою?
uk.R: Так само було і з Рахав, повією. Хіба вона не була виправдана через свої вчинки? Вона прийняла чоловіків, які прийшли як посланці, і допомогла їм утекти іншою дорогою.

ja.L: 同じように、遊女ラハブもまた、使者たちを迎え入れ、別の道から[彼らを]送り出したとき、行いによって義とされたのではありませんか？
ja.B: 同じように、遊女ラハブも、使者たちを家に迎え入れ、別の道を通らせて送り出したとき、行いによって義とされたのではありませんか？
ja.R: ラハブの場合も同じです。売春婦だったラハブも、その行動によって、神に正しい者と認められたのではありませんか？ラハブは、使いとして来た男の人たちを家に迎え、別の道から逃がしてあげたのです。

decisions.choice: Rahab: Joshua 2 and 6
decisions.reason: Rahab hid the two men Joshua sent to Jericho and let them down by a rope through her window (Joshua 2:1-21). She and her family were spared when the city fell (Joshua 6:22-25). She told them, that the LORD their God is God in heaven above and on earth below (Joshua 2:11), and Hebrews 11:31 says she acted "by faith".

decisions.choice: the prostitute: an outsider, set beside Abraham
decisions.reason: Abraham was the honored father of Israel; Rahab was a foreign woman with a shameful trade. James chooses examples from both ends of the scale to show that the same rule holds for everyone (compare 2:1-4).

decisions.choice: messengers: the men Joshua sent
decisions.reason: ἄγγελος can mean "angel" or "messenger". Here it is the two spies of Joshua 2.

decisions.choice: counted righteous
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep "justified", the word the argument turns on, so that James 2:21-25 can be compared with Romans 3-4. Readable says "counted righteous", which says in plain words what the verdict is (see the meaning decision on δικαιόω).

decisions.choice: the men who came as messengers; helped them escape
decisions.reason: Readable says who the messengers were and what sending them out by another way meant.

decisions.choice: "사자들" (L); "정탐꾼들" (B); "정탐하러 온 사람들" (R)
decisions.reason: The word can mean angels, but here it is the men Joshua sent (meaning decision). "사자" (envoy) keeps the Greek word at Literal; Balanced and Readable say who they were, from Joshua 2.

decisions.choice: "라합"; "창녀" at every level
decisions.reason: "라합" is the established Protestant form. The meaning decision says her status as an outsider is the point, set beside Abraham; "기생" softens it to an entertainer.

decisions.choice: "kỹ nữ" for the prostitute; "bà" for Rahab
decisions.reason: "Kỹ nữ" names her trade plainly without the coarseness of "gái điếm", which is not the register of public reading. She is a grown woman in an ancient story, so Vietnamese calls her "bà".

decisions.choice: "ラハブ"; "遊女" (L, B), "売春婦" (R)
decisions.reason: Rahab is not in the style guide's name list; "ラハブ" follows the Hebrew and Greek sound and is the usual Japanese form. "遊女" is the established word for her trade in Japanese Bible reading; Readable uses the plain modern word, written in Jōyō kanji.

source.text: ὥσπερ γὰρ τὸ σῶμα χωρὶς πνεύματος νεκρόν ἐστιν, οὕτως καὶ ἡ πίστις χωρὶς ἔργων νεκρά ἐστιν.

records.literal_gloss: Just as for the body without spirit dead is, so also the faith without works dead is.

en.L: For just as the body without spirit is dead, so also faith without works is dead.
en.B: Just as a body with no spirit in it is dead, so faith with no works is dead too.
en.R: A body without a spirit is dead. In the same way, faith without actions is dead.

es.L: Porque así como el cuerpo sin espíritu está muerto, así también la fe sin obras está muerta.
es.B: Así como un cuerpo sin espíritu está muerto, también la fe sin obras está muerta.
es.R: Un cuerpo sin espíritu está muerto. De la misma manera, la fe sin obras está muerta.

sw.L: Kwa maana kama vile mwili bila roho ni mfu, vivyo hivyo pia imani bila matendo ni mfu.
sw.B: Kama mwili usio na roho ndani yake ulivyo mfu, ndivyo na imani isiyo na matendo ilivyo mfu.
sw.R: Mwili usio na roho umekufa. Vivyo hivyo, imani isiyo na matendo imekufa.

fr.L: Car, comme le corps sans esprit est mort, ainsi aussi la foi sans œuvres est morte.
fr.B: Comme un corps sans esprit est mort, de même la foi sans œuvres est morte.
fr.R: Un corps sans esprit est mort. De la même façon, la foi sans actes est morte.

ko.L: 영이 없는 몸이 죽은 것과 같이, 행함이 없는 믿음도 죽은 것입니다.
ko.B: 영이 없는 몸이 죽은 것처럼, 행함이 없는 믿음도 죽은 것입니다.
ko.R: 영이 없는 몸은 죽은 것입니다. 마찬가지로, 행동이 없는 믿음도 죽은 것입니다.

vi.L: Vì như thân thể không có linh hồn thì chết, đức tin không có việc làm cũng chết như vậy.
vi.B: Như thân thể không có hơi thở sự sống thì chết, đức tin không có việc làm cũng chết như vậy.
vi.R: Thân thể không có linh hồn thì chết. Cũng vậy, đức tin không có hành động thì chết.

pt.L: Pois, assim como o corpo sem espírito está morto, assim também a fé sem obras está morta.
pt.B: Um corpo em que não há espírito está morto; do mesmo modo, a fé em que não há obras está morta.
pt.R: Um corpo sem espírito está morto. Do mesmo jeito, a fé sem ações está morta.

am.L: ሰውነት ያለ መንፈስ የሞተ እንደ ሆነ እንዲሁ ደግሞ እምነት ያለ ሥራ የሞተ ነውና።
am.B: መንፈስ የሌለበት ሰውነት የሞተ እንደ ሆነ ሁሉ፣ ሥራ የሌለው እምነትም የሞተ ነው።
am.R: መንፈስ የሌለው ሰውነት የሞተ ነው። እንደዚሁም ተግባር የሌለው እምነት የሞተ ነው።

hi.L: क्योंकि जैसे शरीर आत्मा के बिना मरा हुआ है, वैसे ही विश्वास भी कामों के बिना मरा हुआ है।
hi.B: जैसे जिस शरीर में आत्मा न हो वह मरा हुआ है, वैसे ही जिस विश्वास के साथ काम न हों वह भी मरा हुआ है।
hi.R: आत्मा के बिना शरीर मरा हुआ है। उसी तरह, कामों के बिना विश्वास मरा हुआ है।

ru.L: Ведь как тело без духа мертво, так и вера без дел мертва.
ru.B: Тело, в котором нет духа, мертво, и точно так же мертва вера, в которой нет дел.
ru.R: Тело без духа мертво. Точно так же и вера без дел мертва.

uk.L: Бо як тіло без духу мертве, так і віра без діл мертва.
uk.B: Як тіло, у якому немає духу, мертве, так і віра, у якій немає діл, теж мертва.
uk.R: Тіло без духу мертве. Так само й віра без учинків мертва.

ja.L: なぜなら、霊のない体が死んでいるのと同じように、行いのない信仰も死んでいるからです。
ja.B: 霊のない体が死んでいるように、行いのない信仰も死んでいるのです。
ja.R: 体は、霊がなければ死んでいます。同じように、信仰も、行動がなければ死んでいるのです。

decisions.choice: spirit: the life God breathes into a body
decisions.reason: πνεῦμα can mean spirit or breath. When God breathed into the man he became alive (Genesis 2:7), and at death the spirit goes back to God who gave it (Ecclesiastes 12:7). A body without it is a corpse.

decisions.choice: the comparison: faith is like the body, works like the spirit
decisions.reason: One might expect faith to be the spirit and works the body. James puts it the other way: works are what show that faith is alive, as breath shows that a body is alive. Without them faith is a corpse.

decisions.choice: dead: cannot save
decisions.reason: This repeats verse 17 and answers the question of verse 14: a dead faith cannot save. James does not set works against faith; he sets living faith against dead faith.

decisions.choice: actions
decisions.reason: Readable says "actions" for ἔργον, a common word for what people do; Literal and Balanced keep "works" through 2:14-26 so that the argument's key word stays visible.

decisions.choice: "영" for the spirit of the body
decisions.reason: The spirit is the life God breathes into a body (meaning decision); "영" is the word used for the human spirit, lowercase in sense, and not "성령".

decisions.choice: "linh hồn" (L, R); "hơi thở sự sống" (B) for spirit, lowercase
decisions.reason: The spirit here is the life God breathes into a body (m1), not the Holy Spirit. "Linh hồn" is the plain Vietnamese word for what leaves the body at death; Balanced names the breath of life, the picture of Genesis 2:7.
